Let S_k be the closed line segment from P_k to P_{k+1} for 0 <= k < len(distance). The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail) and r = true if and only if there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(distance) and j >= i+2 such that S_i and S_j intersect (i.e., share at least one point).
